## Summary

Ferrous Gate Engineering Ltd (policy CC-1703): theft of a laptop and an external drive from a locked storage unit at a university library. Covered under clause 4.2, subject to one point to confirm (the date of loss, for exclusion 7.5). Reserve 4,732 dollars.

## Facts

Ferrous Gate Engineering Ltd reported the loss on 26 September 2026 [notice of loss]. The loss occurred at a university library [notice of loss]. The items are a laptop and an external drive [notice of loss], [invoice 1], [invoice 2]. The theft was reported to the police on 28 September 2026, reference CR/2026/4247 [police report]. The items were in a locked container at the time [police report]. The file does not state the date of the loss itself [notice of loss], [police report]. The file contains no policy schedule [policy].

## Coverage analysis

The loss falls under clause 4.2 of the policy, which covers loss of or damage to business contents at any other premises while in the insured's custody, caused by theft [policy]. The file shows the items were in a locked storage unit at the library [notice of loss], [police report]; it does not say in terms whose unit it was, so custody is taken from the insured's report of the loss.

Exclusion 7.1 does not apply: the library is a shared or public space, but the items were in a locked container at the time [police report], [policy].

Exclusion 7.5 cannot be fully cleared on the file. Theft is alleged, so the loss must have been reported to the police within seven days [policy]. The police report is dated 28 September 2026 [police report], and the loss occurred on or before the notice of loss on 26 September 2026 [notice of loss], but the date of the loss is not in the file. The exclusion does not apply if the loss occurred on or after 21 September 2026. The date of loss should be confirmed with the insured.

Exclusions 7.3 (wear and tear) and clause 4.5 (transit) do not arise on these facts: the loss is a theft, not gradual deterioration [notice of loss], [policy].

## Decision

Covered under clause 4.2. The claim is accepted, subject to confirmation that the date of loss falls within seven days before the police report of 28 September 2026, so that exclusion 7.5 does not apply.

## Reserve

The reserve is 4,732 dollars, the sum of the two invoices (2,603 dollars and 2,129 dollars) [invoice 1], [invoice 2]. No excess is shown in the file, and under clause 9.1 none applies where the schedule shows none [policy]. The schedule is not in the file, so this should be checked against it when it is obtained.
